name: Women For Pastors
overview: Scripture acknowledges the important roles women hold within the church and community, highlighting their involvement in ministry and service. Women like Phebe are commended as servants of the church, demonstrating faithful dedication to God's work (Romans 16:1). The early church engaged with women in prayer and teaching settings, as seen when Paul and his companions spoke to women gathered for prayer (Acts 16:13). Additionally, the familial and tribal responsibilities of women in Israel are emphasized, ensuring the preservation of inheritance within the tribes (Numbers 36:8). These passages collectively affirm that women support and sustain the spiritual leadership and life of the church in vital ways.
